# Motion Spotlight Cards

Card grid where one light follows the pointer across all cards: the nearest borders glow and the card under the pointer lights up softly. Each card has icon, title, text, badge and an optional link.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_MOTION_SPOTLIGHT_CARDS` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/motionSpotlightCards` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |

Each query row is one card. The effect needs a mouse or trackpad; on touch screens the cards show as clean static cards. Colors follow the theme primary color.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Card heading. |
| `text` | Text | sessionStateValue |  |  | Supporting text under the title. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class, for example fa-bar-chart. |
| `badge` | Badge | sessionStateValue |  |  | Small label in the corner, for example New or a count. |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional target for the whole card. Must be developer-controlled. |
| `columns` | Columns | selectList (`two`, `three`, `four`) |  |  | Leave empty to fit as many cards as the width allows. Fixed column counts collapse to one column on phones. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/motion-spotlight-cards/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_motion_spotlight_cards.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
